SOD TERMS AND PRIVACY — LOCAL REVIEW COPY
Prepared October 23, 2026.

SCOPE
privacy/index.html and terms/index.html are complete proposed pages for the
Sneferu website and private Software On Demand signup. They are marked as
review copies, noindex/nofollow, and not yet effective. The signup form and
footer have permanent links independent of the offer API's optional terms_url.
No purchase consent record, checkbox, API change, or billing change is claimed.
The scrolling sales page, Contact flow, and checkout JavaScript are unchanged.

COMPANY DECISIONS RECORDED — OCTOBER 23, 2026
Mike expressly corrected the proposed opt-in-only training promise:
"leave that off"; Distillery may use project material to train models.
He then clarified: "PII wil not be used but other stuff mihgt."
The specific corrections govern over the generic async choice "Yes-use both
commitments." The revised Privacy and Terms therefore disclose possible use
of non-PII material, including private project material, for Sneferu model
training, fine-tuning, and evaluation. No opt-in-only promise remains.
The no-sale/no-cross-context-advertising commitment remains accepted.

PII exclusion is the owner's policy commitment, not proof of a working
anonymization or training-data filter. No new training, corpus ingestion,
personal-data processing, or Distillery implementation was performed.
Before any training use, the actual data handling must meet this commitment
and any applicable agreement or legal requirement. External provider terms
remain separate; no universal provider retention/training promise is made.
The company-choice question is answered; do not ask it again.

OTHER ADOPTION NOTES
The text is a proposed company agreement, not a certification of legal
compliance. Confirm it matches actual operations, including receipt/handling
of privacy and refund requests at mike@sneferu.ai. It does not invent a fixed
retention period, provider training guarantee, data-residency promise, blanket
no-refund rule, liability cap, arbitration clause, or governing-law selection.
Assess any jurisdiction-specific notices or contractual additions needed for
actual customers and processing before adopting the text.

The exact live monthly price remains outside this change. Prices, tax, usage,
cloud fees, and any premium follow the offer/order; promotions apply only to
the monthly node fee. Private nodes have no per-build package charge. Test
checkout is distinguished from live charging. No production price is changed.

SOURCE BASIS
Website source: main at 89286e77f50d893ce4a81142c47a21ffcda9ea1b.
- sod/signup/index.html: name/email/promotion, sessionStorage recovery,
  hosted Stripe checkout, dynamic pricing and separate optional offer terms.
- sod/launching/index.html: order recovery and service progress.
- index.html and sod/index.html: company name, Formspree contact form,
  Google Fonts. GitHub Pages hosting is described in README.md/workflow.

Installed application source inspected at c339eaf5d7788a72094447dd14db5781920f589f:
- orchestrator/sod/accounts.py: identities, password hashes, sessions.
- orchestrator/sod/rights.py: community vs owner-only capabilities.
- orchestrator/sod/agent_oauth_store.py and research_data_binding.py:
  authorized connections; revocation is not erasure of imported/returned data.
- orchestrator/sod/store.py: project/upload deletion, not a universal account
  deletion operation or a complete retention schedule.
- orchestrator/sod/account_email.py: invitation and service-email records.
- orchestrator/billing/node_offer.py, node_usage.py, stripe_adapter.py:
  hosted checkout, subscription/order references, measured usage.
- Native private-node template: billing disabled within purchased nodes,
  configured AI providers include Fireworks AI and Baseten.

Existing source-grounded draft consulted:
claudopus/plugins/sneferu/public-works-directory/privacy-policy.html and
privacy-policy-review.txt. That draft was not treated as adopted policy.
Public Works community visibility is not represented as private-node access.

All 19 existing Python site/purchase contract tests passed. Artifact validation
passed for 271 files: links/anchors, IDs, CNAME, contact form, file limits,
private exclusions, and preserved research deployment receipts.

and signup's separate Privacy tab checked. Signup fields remained blank;
no checkout, payment, contact, or account form was submitted. Viewport reset.
Localhost checkout availability is not production checkout acceptance.

PUBLICATION PREPARATION — OCTOBER 23, 2026
The company choices above are resolved by Mike’s direct review and corrections.
His subsequent instructions to finish and publish the work are the release
authority. The only public changes in this finalization are the effective date
and removal of draft/noindex markings. No substantive term or privacy promise
was added. Prior review-copy validation and release status above are historical.
This release does not retroactively change an existing order, certify legal
compliance, prove a training filter, or change payment or project runtime.
Actual public deployment and URL verification are recorded separately.
